dedupe_keys.name: amsterdam metropolitan ev planning mobility electricity and parking data

description: This Amsterdam Metropolitan Area dataset combines mobility, parking capacity, electricity demand, census and cadastre information for electric-vehicle infrastructure planning. Wageningen researchers aggregate information from 1,661 residential zones to seventy-nine three-digit postcode areas using source data generated during 2017–2019. The deposit includes polygon geometry and an origin-destination analysis between those areas. Mendeley provides free access under CC BY 4.0. The repository description and article say CSV for the origin-destination output, but the inspected file inventory lists an Excel workbook alongside Shapefile components. This format discrepancy is retained without assuming a missing CSV. Spatial aggregation limits street-level charger placement, and the snapshot does not describe current demand. A reviewer-assessed use is studying mobility and electricity interdependencies or testing charging-location scenarios in simulations. data-openstreetmap supplies related street context, and model-sumo provides traffic modelling; neither connection was tested here.
name: Amsterdam metropolitan EV-planning mobility, electricity and parking data
